title: Lion cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='27' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#f6c360'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#e07b9a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#e07b9a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='19' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fff2c9'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='41' r='3.6' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='3.6' fill='#5a3a1a'/>

  <path d='M46 51 L54 51 L50 55 Z' fill='#8a5a2b'/>

  <circle cx='43' cy='53' r='0.9' fill='#c9944a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='53' r='0.9' fill='#c9944a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M32 66 Q50 76 68 66 L68 73 Q50 83 32 73 Z' fill='#e0455a'/>
  <path d='M32 66 Q50 76 68 66 L68 69 Q50 79 32 69 Z' fill='#ff8a9a'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M64 72 Q72 76 70 86 L63 84 Q64 78 60 74 Z' fill='#e0455a'/>
